themes.disagreements: Lesion size (183) and mass localization (166) exhibit dual roles as confounders and effect modifiers; proliferative markers (196, 197) and dissection procedure (201) are primarily effect modifiers, while others (182, 193, 195, 198, 199, 200, 202) show negligible signals.
themes.interpretation: Tumor morphological and nodal assessments ranging from negligible prognostic signals to robust dual roles in confounding and treatment heterogeneity.
themes.name: Tumor Morphological and Nodal Assessment

themes.disagreements: PET metrics (164, 168) and lobectomy type (190) demonstrate dual roles as confounders and effect modifiers; orbital/cranial findings (173) and leptomeningeal enhancement (181) are primarily effect modifiers, while others remain purely prognostic.
themes.interpretation: Advanced radiographic imaging findings showing a spectrum from purely prognostic importance to strong treatment heterogeneity and confounding.
themes.name: Advanced Radiographic Imaging

themes.disagreements: High consistency across Ki67, KEAP1, and KRAS VAF, all showing strong signals for effect modification and outcome prognosis.
themes.interpretation: Molecular and proliferative biomarkers acting as consistent indicators of treatment effect modification.
themes.name: Molecular and Pathological Biomarkers

themes.disagreements: Line of therapy (184) and calcium carbonate (203) show dual roles; cisplatin (204), denosumab (205), and G12C inhibitors (207) are primarily effect modifiers; lisinopril (209) is a clear confounder.
themes.interpretation: Pharmacotherapy agents with divergent roles ranging from simple confounding to complex effect modification and prognosis.
themes.name: Pharmacotherapy and Systemic Treatment

themes.disagreements: Pulmonary diagnosis (194), liver metastasis (188), and baseline health markers (170) show dual roles; illicit drug use (162) is primarily a confounder, while general liver function (187) and auscultation (191) are negligible or prognostic.
themes.interpretation: Comorbidities and organ-specific health markers showing varying levels of confounding and treatment heterogeneity.
themes.name: Organ Function and Comorbidities

themes.disagreements: Knee osteoarthritis (177) is a dominant confounder, whereas other clinical assessments (174, 180) provide only weak or purely prognostic signals.
themes.interpretation: General clinical and laboratory metrics where confounding is limited to specific markers.
themes.name: Clinical and Laboratory Metrics

themes.disagreements: Morphine (217) demonstrates dual roles; living arrangements (189) act as a confounder, while oxycodone (211) remains purely prognostic.
themes.interpretation: Social context and pain management markers with divergent roles in treatment prediction and effect modification.
themes.name: Social and Pain Management

themes.disagreements: Prior immunotherapy (169) demonstrates dual roles as a confounder and effect modifier, while imaging procedures (163) are primarily effect modifiers.
themes.interpretation: Procedural and therapy history markers providing evidence for treatment heterogeneity and confounding.
themes.name: Procedural and Therapy History
